# Invented-only current-Python pandas/SciPy compatibility

This is preparation for a bounded operational check, not a localization experiment. No project sequence, effect, feature array or checkpoint is opened. All original runtime certificates, scientific sources, resource safeguards and failed attempts remain unchanged. Native execution requires this preparation manifest to be committed exactly to HEAD and an explicit root start. There is one attempt, no automatic retry, installation or network access.

The existing scientific receipt lists NumPy 1.26.4, pandas 2.2.3 and SciPy 1.14.1 with CPython 3.12 Windows extensions. Inventory every file under those packages, their .libs and .dist-info directories and the explicitly enumerated Python dependencies. Require exact membership and hashes against the old receipt. This proves unchanged observed payloads; only NumPy has the separately recorded official wheel-member parity. No fresh official publisher provenance for pandas/SciPy is asserted. The full 10,808-file prefix inventory is preparation metadata, not a fresh worker-wide compatibility certificate.

Current bundled Python 3.12.14 is attested separately. The old interpreter binaries are unavailable, so **old_interpreter_bitwise_parity_established is false**. Bind the current attestation, executable, root DLLs and DLLs/ extensions; verify the actual loaded Python DLL paths. Require the earlier current-Python inventory and successful NumPy v2 profile receipts to be committed before this freeze. The v2 payload checker is reused; its two-thread run function is never called.

The future worker selects only the current Python standard-library paths, this repository and the pinned scientific prefix. No addsitedir or .pth execution occurs. Recheck exact NumPy/pandas/SciPy/dependency payloads before import and after calculations. Record every loaded scientific module and actual native path/hash. Reject foreign numerical extensions or matching pinned native basenames from another path. Record loaded Python standard-library extensions separately. After numerical calls, threadpoolctl must report one thread for every loaded BLAS/OpenMP pool, with its library inside the pinned native roster. Unused DLLs are not claimed to have been loaded. This is a narrow tested-operation compatibility check, not renewal of the old full-runtime identity.

## Original deferred parser

Use the unchanged original expression from src/generalization_knowncell_20261007/common.py: read_csv(usecols=['intervention_id','measured_delta'], low_memory=False, skiprows=lambda number: number>0 and number not in set(original_core_row+1)), exact selected ID/order assertion, then measured_delta.to_numpy(float) and finite-value assertion. Do not specify a different float_precision, engine, dtype, sorting or Python float replacement. Compare the actual new deferred pandas_effects function to that exact expression on invented StringIO and BytesIO streams. A mock may use simple Python floats only to verify plumbing; that is not the actual compatibility operation.

Freeze invented cases before execution: LF and CRLF, first/last and sparse physical-row masks, quoted unused commas, skipped invalid numeric tokens, difficult decimal/exponent/subnormal/large-integer strings, and exact IEEE-754 golden bytes for 1.25, -2.5, +0, -0 and 2^53. Record tricky-token outputs without declaring Python-float conversion the oracle. Strict invented metadata prerequisites reject duplicate/empty IDs, duplicate headers, malformed width/quotes and multiline records incompatible with the original physical-row mask. Reject selected nonfinite or malformed numeric values and reordered expected IDs. Wrapper-level rejection is distinguished from pandas' own parser behavior. No equality to an unavailable old-interpreter output is asserted.

## Actual deferred optimizer and scorer

Exercise only the separately prepared generalization_knowncell_joint_numeric_20261022 functions, supplying scientific modules after admission. Import no broad historical loader/fitter. The old optimize source is a pinned reference for L-BFGS-B options maxiter=500, ftol=1e-11 and gtol=1e-7; it is not imported. scipy.special.expit and minimize must resolve from the pinned SciPy payload.

One seed 20261022 creates 128 invented rows, 102 columns, 64 ordered pairs, two balanced cell groups and four declared pair blocks. Two columns are constant/zero and a third has below-threshold RMS. Prepare the common pair RMS once for every arm. Test the fixed penalties .005/.05/.5: pooled102 (three optimizer units), independent two102 heads with conditional 2w and the same lambda (six units), and joint204 fixed shrink10 (three units). No alternate shrinkage or optimizer option is searched.

At fixed nonzero coefficients, compare every objective and gradient to the existing standard-library reference (absolute difference <1e-11). Check selected supported and unsupported coordinates by central finite differences with step1e-6 (difference <2e-7). Require zero optimizer initialization and initial logistic loss log(2), detecting incorrectly normalized conditional weights. Every returned fit must report original optimizer success, finite coefficients, exact zero unsupported coefficients and scalar objective agreement <1e-10; record scalar stationarity and require maximum absolute gradient <1e-5. Compare full128-row canonical scores against the scalar reference (<1e-10), JSON round-trip replay and unchanged scores when unsupported inputs are perturbed. The canonical joint scorer forms beta+/-delta before both complete full-shape matrix products. These checks do not certify future metadata/sampling/checkpoint bindings or real biological convergence.

## Resource and output policy

One fresh detached scientific child uses the unchanged headless Job implementation: process commit cap768MiB, aggregate896MiB, active processes2, kill on close, no breakaway. The second process allowance covers at most a pinned direct Git provenance helper. OMP_NUM_THREADS, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS, MKL_NUM_THREADS and NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS are all1; UTF8 and no-bytecode are required. Start with physical free>=512MiB, commit headroom>=896MiB+1GiB and disk>=1GiB. Stop below256MiB physical,1GiB system commitment or256MiB disk, and after120seconds. Check the final elapsed time and reserves as well as polling; query final process lifetime peak counters before closing its handle. Preserve logs, failures and any partial receipts. A failure requires separate review and a new attempt namespace or explicit additive attempt; no overwrite.

The native worker writes actual_origin_receipt.json, a concise pandas_admission_candidate.json and invented_profile_receipt.json. The supervisor must independently pass before any candidate admission is usable. The pandas candidate uses the loader's prospective exact contract, with biological_rows_read=model_fits=0. New biological fitting, if later authorized, requires every control to run under the verified new runtime; no old checkpoint reuse follows from this test. This profile does not read biological labels, prove generalization or make a novelty claim.

"""Invented CSVs and original deferred pandas expression; no package imports."""
import csv
import io
import math
import struct

TRICKY = ('0.1', '0.30000000000000004', '1.0000000000000002',
          '2.2250738585072014e-308', '1.7976931348623157e308', '5e-324',
          '-0.0', '-2.5e+12', '9007199254740993', '1e-300')


def csv_text(rows, newline='\n'):
    text = io.StringIO(newline='')
    writer = csv.writer(text, lineterminator=newline)
    writer.writerow(('intervention_id', 'measured_delta', 'unused'))
    writer.writerows(rows)
    return text.getvalue()


def metadata(text, positions):
    """Invented metadata prerequisite; never numerically converts CSV values."""
    reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO(text, newline=''), strict=True)
    header = next(reader)
    assert len(set(header)) == len(header) and set(header) == {'intervention_id', 'measured_delta', 'unused'}
    assert reader.line_num == 1
    previous = 1; rows = []; seen = set()
    for row in reader:
        assert reader.line_num == previous + 1, 'Original mask requires one physical line per record'
        previous = reader.line_num
        assert len(row) == len(header), 'Malformed width'
        intervention = row[header.index('intervention_id')]
        assert intervention and intervention not in seen, 'Empty/duplicate original IDs'
        seen.add(intervention); rows.append(intervention)
    assert positions == sorted(set(positions)) and positions
    assert all(type(i) is int and 0 <= i < len(rows) for i in positions)
    return {'rows': [{'intervention_id': rows[i]} for i in positions],
            'original_core_rows': positions, 'one_csv_record_per_physical_line': True}


def original_pandas(text, pandas_module, selected):
    """The original common.load(outcomes=True) parsing call, on invented text."""
    keep = set(value + 1 for value in selected['original_core_rows'])
    values = pandas_module.read_csv(io.StringIO(text), usecols=['intervention_id', 'measured_delta'],
                                   low_memory=False,
                                   skiprows=lambda number: number > 0 and number not in keep)
    assert list(values.intervention_id) == [r['intervention_id'] for r in selected['rows']]
    effects = values.measured_delta.to_numpy(float)
    assert all(math.isfinite(value) for value in effects)
    return list(values.intervention_id), effects


def float_bytes(values):
    return b''.join(struct.pack('<d', value) for value in values)


def successful_cases():
    # Disallowed selected numeric strings remain harmless when outside the old
    # physical-row keep mask; they are deliberately not converted by metadata.
    rows = [('skip_first', 'not_a_number', 'comma,quoted')]
    for i, value in enumerate(TRICKY):
        rows.extend([(f'kept_{i:02}', value, 'unused'), (f'skip_{i:02}', 'Infinity', 'unused')])
    rows.append(('last_kept', '2.5', 'tail'))
    positions = list(range(1, 2 * len(TRICKY), 2)) + [len(rows)-1]
    return [('tricky_lf', csv_text(rows), positions),
            ('tricky_crlf', csv_text(rows, '\r\n'), positions),
            ('first_and_last', csv_text([('first', '1.25', 'x'), ('middle', 'bad', 'x'), ('last', '-2.5', 'x')]), [0, 2])]


def rejected_csv_cases():
    return [
        ('duplicate_ids', csv_text([('a','1','x'),('a','2','x')]), [0]),
        ('empty_id', csv_text([('','1','x')]), [0]),
        ('multiline', csv_text([('a','1','multi\nline')]), [0]),
        ('duplicate_header', 'intervention_id,measured_delta,intervention_id\na,1,a\n', [0]),
        ('bad_width', 'intervention_id,measured_delta,unused\na,1\n', [0]),
        ('bad_quote', 'intervention_id,measured_delta,unused\na,1,"unterminated\n', [0]),
    ]


def rejected_numeric_cases():
    return [(word, csv_text([('a', word, 'x')]), [0]) for word in
            ('bad_float', 'NaN', 'inf', '-inf', '', '1e309')]

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
NS = 'generalization_knowncell_parser_profile_20261022'
SRC, REP, OUT = [ROOT / part / NS for part in ('src', 'reports', 'results')]
MANIFEST = OUT / 'preparation_manifest.json'
INVENTORY = OUT / 'payload_inventory.json'
RUNTIME = ROOT / 'artifacts/generalization_splicebert_runtime_compatibility_20261007/scientific_runtime_receipt.json'
PYTHON = ROOT / 'results/generalization_current_python_20261022/current_python_inventory.json'
PREFIX = ROOT / 'data/interim/mechanism_v2/runtime'
COMPONENTS = (
    'numpy', 'numpy.libs', 'numpy-1.26.4.dist-info',
    'pandas', 'pandas.libs', 'pandas-2.2.3.dist-info',
    'scipy', 'scipy.libs', 'scipy-1.14.1.dist-info',
    'dateutil', 'python_dateutil-2.9.0.post0.dist-info',
    'pytz', 'pytz-2026.3.post1.dist-info', 'tzdata', 'tzdata-2026.3.dist-info',
    'six.py', 'six-1.17.0.dist-info', 'packaging', 'packaging-26.3.dist-info',
    'threadpoolctl.py', 'threadpoolctl-3.6.0.dist-info',
)
THREAD_ENV = {name: '1' for name in ('OMP_NUM_THREADS', 'OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS',
                                    'MKL_NUM_THREADS', 'NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS')}
THREAD_ENV.update(PYTHONUTF8='1', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
OPTIONS = {'maxiter': 500, 'ftol': 1e-11, 'gtol': 1e-7}
PENALTIES = (.005, .05, .5)
STATUS = 'FROZEN_INVENTED_ONE_THREAD_PANDAS_SCIPY_CURRENT_PYTHON_PROFILE'
NATIVE_PASS = 'PASS_CURRENT_PYTHON_PANDAS_ORIGINS_AND_INVENTED_PARSER_COMPATIBILITY'


def sha(path):
    value = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b''): value.update(block)
    return value.hexdigest()


def jsave(path, value):
    path = Path(path)
    assert path.parent.resolve() == OUT.resolve()
    with path.open('x', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n')


def payload_members(files):
    """No filename/type guessing: explicitly enumerated old-receipt components."""
    wanted = {name: value for name, value in files.items() if name.split('/')[0] in COMPONENTS}
    assert {name.split('/')[0] for name in wanted} == set(COMPONENTS), 'Required package absent; do not install'
    return wanted


def native_members(files):
    return {name: value for name, value in files.items() if Path(name).suffix.lower() in ('.dll', '.pyd')}


def check_payload_files(expected, prefix=PREFIX):
    prefix = Path(prefix).resolve()
    actual = set()
    for component in COMPONENTS:
        path = prefix / component
        paths = [path] if path.is_file() else path.rglob('*')
        for item in paths:
            if item.is_file():
                assert not item.is_symlink() and item.resolve().is_relative_to(prefix)
                actual.add(item.relative_to(prefix).as_posix())
    assert actual == set(expected), 'Unexpected/missing pinned package payload'
    for name, want in expected.items(): assert sha(prefix / name) == want, name
    return len(actual)


def resource_failure(state, elapsed, active_processes=1, startup=False):
    if elapsed > 120: return 'Invented120second deadline exceeded'
    if state['physical_available'] < (512 if startup else 256) * 2**20: return 'Physical reserve floor violated'
    required_commit = 2**30 + (896 * 2**20 if startup else 0)
    if state['commit_headroom'] < required_commit: return 'System commitment reserve violated'
    if state['disk_available'] < (1024 if startup else 256) * 2**20: return 'Disk reserve violated'
    if active_processes > 2: return 'Owned active-process cap exceeded'
    return None


def check_thread_environment(environ):
    assert all(environ.get(key) == value for key, value in THREAD_ENV.items()), 'Exact one-thread UTF8/no-bytecode environment required'

"""Invented-only checks of the actual separately frozen deferred solver."""
import json
import math
from .common import OPTIONS


def run(np, minimize, expit):
    from src.generalization_knowncell_joint_numeric_20261022 import numeric
    from src.generalization_knowncell_joint_numeric_20261022.spec import CONFIGS
    from src.generalization_knowncell_joint_implementation_20261022 import kernels
    rng = np.random.RandomState(20261022)
    x = rng.normal(0., .05, size=(128, 102))
    x[:,99] *= 1e-12; x[:,100] = 9.; x[:,101] = 0.
    left = np.arange(64, dtype=np.int64); right = left+64
    cells = ['CAD']*32 + ['Neuro-2a']*32
    row_cells = cells+cells
    labels = np.where(np.arange(64)%3 == 0, -1., 1.)
    one = np.arange(1.,33.); one = .5 * one / one.sum()
    weights = np.concatenate((one, one[::-1]))
    prepared = numeric.prepare_training(np, x, left, right, labels, weights, cells)
    differences = (x[left]-x[right]).tolist()
    scaling = kernels.common_scale(differences, weights.tolist())
    assert prepared['scaling']['active'] == scaling['active']
    assert max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(prepared['scaling']['scale'], scaling['scale'])) < 1e-12
    assert prepared['scaling']['active'][-3:] == [False,False,False]
    z, y, w, signs = [prepared[key] for key in ('z','labels','weights','signs')]
    zl, yl, wl = z.tolist(), y.tolist(), w.tolist()
    reference = {'pooled': kernels.pooled_value_gradient,
                 'independent': kernels.independent_value_gradient,
                 'joint_shrink10': kernels.joint_value_gradient}
    calls = []; checks = []

    def checked_minimize(fun, initial, **kwargs):
        assert kwargs == {'jac': True, 'method': 'L-BFGS-B', 'options': OPTIONS}
        assert initial.shape in ((102,), (204,)) and np.all(initial == 0.)
        loss, gradient = fun(initial)
        assert abs(loss-math.log(2.)) < 1e-12, 'Initial conditional weights must sum1'
        assert np.isfinite(gradient).all()
        calls.append({'width': len(initial), 'zero_start_loss': loss,
                      'method': kwargs['method'], 'options': dict(kwargs['options'])})
        return minimize(fun, initial, **kwargs)

    for arm in ('pooled','independent','joint_shrink10'):
        width = 102 if arm == 'pooled' else 204
        theta = np.linspace(-.03,.03,width, dtype=np.float64)
        for config in CONFIGS:
            penalty = config['penalty']
            actual_value, actual_gradient = numeric.objective_value_gradient(np,expit,arm,theta,z,y,w,signs,penalty)
            expected_value, expected_gradient = reference[arm](theta.tolist(),zl,yl,wl,cells,penalty)
            value_difference = abs(actual_value-expected_value)
            gradient_difference = max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(actual_gradient.tolist(),expected_gradient))
            assert value_difference < 1e-11 and gradient_difference < 1e-11
            fd = []
            indices = [0,50,99,100,101] + ([102,152,201,202,203] if width == 204 else [])
            for index in indices:
                plus=theta.copy(); minus=theta.copy(); plus[index]+=1e-6; minus[index]-=1e-6
                high=numeric.objective_value_gradient(np,expit,arm,plus,z,y,w,signs,penalty)[0]
                low=numeric.objective_value_gradient(np,expit,arm,minus,z,y,w,signs,penalty)[0]
                fd.append(abs((high-low)/(2e-6)-actual_gradient[index]))
            assert max(fd) < 2e-7
            model=numeric.fit_prepared(np,checked_minimize,expit,prepared,arm,config)
            if arm == 'independent':
                fitted=model['heads']['CAD']+model['heads']['Neuro-2a']
            else: fitted=model['beta']+model.get('delta',[])
            exact_value, exact_gradient=reference[arm](fitted,zl,yl,wl,cells,penalty)
            assert abs(exact_value-model['objective']) < 1e-10
            assert max(abs(value) for value in exact_gradient) < 1e-5
            prediction=numeric.canonical_scores(np,model,x,row_cells)
            scalar=kernels.reference_scores(arm,x.tolist(),row_cells,model)
            prediction_difference=max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(prediction.tolist(),scalar))
            assert prediction_difference < 1e-10
            saved=json.loads(json.dumps(model, allow_nan=False))
            replay=numeric.canonical_scores(np,saved,x,row_cells)
            assert np.array_equal(prediction,replay)
            changed=x.copy(); changed[:,99:102]+=1e6
            assert np.array_equal(prediction,numeric.canonical_scores(np,model,changed,row_cells))
            checks.append({'arm':arm,'config':config['id'],'objective_difference':value_difference,
                'gradient_max_abs_difference':gradient_difference,'finite_difference_max_abs_difference':max(fd),
                'fitted_objective_difference':abs(exact_value-model['objective']),
                'fitted_scalar_gradient_max_abs':max(abs(value) for value in exact_gradient),
                'canonical_scalar_score_max_abs_difference':prediction_difference,
                'optimizer_units':model['optimizer_units']})
    assert len(calls)==12 and sum(item['width']==204 for item in calls)==3
    return {'status':'PASS_INVENTED_SCIPY_SOLVER_REFERENCE_AND_SCORER',
            'seed':20261022,'invented_rows':128,'invented_pairs':64,'feature_width':102,
            'invented_balanced_cell_groups':2,'nominal_invented_contexts':4,
            'same_prepared_object_all_arms':True,'scipy_optimizer_units':len(calls),
            'checks':checks,'optimizer_calls':calls,

def actual_proof(np, pd, scipy, threadpoolctl, runtime, inventory):

    from src.generalization_current_python_20261022 import attest
    numpy_proof = launcher.numpy_proof(np, runtime)
    prefix = PREFIX.resolve(); python_home = Path(sys.executable).resolve().parent
    for module, version in ((np, '1.26.4'), (pd, '2.2.3'), (scipy, '1.14.1')):
        assert module.__version__ == version
        assert Path(module.__file__).resolve() == prefix/module.__name__/'__init__.py'
    loaded = {}; stdlib_native = {}; observed_native = {}
    for name, module in tuple(sys.modules.items()):
        location = getattr(module, '__file__', None)
        if not location: continue
        path = Path(location).resolve()
        if path.is_relative_to(prefix):
            rel = path.relative_to(prefix).as_posix()
            assert rel in inventory['files'] and sha(path) == inventory['files'][rel], name
            loaded[rel] = inventory['files'][rel]
        elif path.suffix.lower() == '.pyd':
            assert str(path) in inventory['current_python_native_files'], name
            assert sha(path) == inventory['current_python_native_files'][str(path)]
            stdlib_native[str(path)] = sha(path)
        else:
            assert not any(x.lower() in ('site-packages', '.python_packages') for x in path.parts), str(path)
    native = inventory['native_files']
    known_basenames = {Path(key).name.lower() for key in native}
    expected_dlls = {key for key in native if key.lower().endswith('.dll')}
    loaded_prefix_dlls = set()
    for path in launcher.process_native_paths():
        if path.is_relative_to(prefix):
            rel = path.relative_to(prefix).as_posix()
            assert rel in native and sha(path) == native[rel], str(path)
            observed_native[str(path)] = native[rel]
            if rel.lower().endswith('.dll'): loaded_prefix_dlls.add(rel)
        elif path.name.lower() in known_basenames:
            raise AssertionError('Pinned scientific native basename loaded elsewhere: ' + str(path))
        elif str(path) in inventory['current_python_native_files']:
            assert sha(path) == inventory['current_python_native_files'][str(path)]
            stdlib_native[str(path)] = sha(path)
        else:
            assert path.suffix.lower() != '.pyd', 'Foreign native extension ' + str(path)
    pools = threadpoolctl.threadpool_info()
    assert pools and {pool['user_api'] for pool in pools} <= {'blas', 'openmp'}

    assert any('scipy.libs/' in key for key in loaded_prefix_dlls)

    current_python = attest.native_python(python['python_native_files'])
    return {'current_python_inventory_sha256': sha(PYTHON), 'python_version': sys.version,
            'actually_loaded_Python_DLLs': current_python,
            'actually_loaded_current_python_native_files': stdlib_native,
            'actually_loaded_scientific_modules': loaded,
            'actually_loaded_scientific_native_files': observed_native,
            'actually_loaded_threadpools': pools, 'numpy_original_payload_proof': numpy_proof,
            'old_interpreter_bitwise_parity_established': False,
            'old_exact_runtime_identity_passes': False,
            'expected_unused_scientific_dlls_not_claimed_loaded': sorted(expected_dlls-loaded_prefix_dlls)}
